name: Tammra Windfield
summary: At Sun Rock Retreat, Tammra Windfield guides Horde travelers in honoring the land's renewal. She watches over the Stonetalon wilderness and the safety of her kin.

sections.title: A Warden of Sun Rock
sections.body: Sun Rock Retreat shelters the Horde among the crags of Stonetalon. Harpies, Venture Company loggers, and predators threaten the settlement. Tammra Windfield watches over the mountain wilderness and the travelers who enter. Her gentle manner is matched by the resolve to keep a home safe in such rugged country.

sections.title: Nurturing the Land
sections.body: Tammra honors the Earth Mother by tending to nature's steady rhythm of growth and decay. She asks travelers to help renew the land and bring forth new life. Conflict and exploitation have harmed Stonetalon, so she works to heal the mountain soil and let life flourish again.

sections.title: Kinship and Vigilance
sections.body: Tammra's care reaches beyond the wilds to the companions and kin who travel Stonetalon's dangerous trails. When travelers or family vanish among the crags, she is among the first to seek reliable aid. Sun Rock Retreat endures through loyalty, mutual protection, and harmony with nature.

faq.answer: Tammra Windfield is a tauren at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. She cares for the settlement, the mountain's natural cycles, and the safety of her fellow travelers.

faq.q: Where can I find Tammra Windfield?
faq.answer: Find Tammra inside Sun Rock Retreat, the Horde encampment in the western heights of the Stonetalon Mountains. A mountain trail branches off the main valley road and leads there.
Tammra asks travelers to help renew the land and protect her kin. Her requests include Cycle of Rebirth, New Life, and Kaya's Alive, where travelers report on kin's survival.

faq.q: What is Tammra's role in Sun Rock Retreat?
faq.answer: Tammra cares for the community and its spiritual life at Sun Rock Retreat. She guides travelers in restoring the surrounding wilderness and protecting the bonds that keep the outpost safe.

faq.q: Why does Tammra care about the natural cycle?
faq.answer: Tauren believe balance depends on nurturing the Earth Mother's cycles of death and regeneration. Outside forces and mountain beasts threaten the region, so Tammra seeks new life to heal the wounded wilderness.

faq.q: Is Tammra friendly to Alliance players?
faq.answer: No. Sun Rock Retreat is a Horde outpost, and Tammra is aligned with Thunder Bluff and the Horde. She is hostile to Alliance intruders.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can see Tammra's devotion to the Earth Mother in her work to restore the land, even far from Mulgore.
As a druid, you can hear how Tammra's care for rebirth and new life echoes the heart of druidism.
As a member of the Horde, you can help Tammra keep Sun Rock Retreat a secure, lasting foothold for Horde travelers in contested Stonetalon.
